arxiv-2102-05093.title: Global solutions of the two-dimensional Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation with a linearly growing mode in each direction Thanks: ∗ corresponding author
arxiv-2102-05093.creator: David M. Ambrose ∗, Anna L. Mazzucato
arxiv-2102-05093.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by David M. Ambrose ∗, Anna L. Mazzucato. We consider the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation in two space dimension. We establish the first proof of global existence of solutions in the presence of a linearly growing mode in both spatial directions for sufficiently small data. We develop a new method to this end, categorizing wavenumbers as low (linearly growing modes), intermediate (linearly decaying modes that serve as energy sinks for the low modes), and high (strongly linearly decaying modes).

arxiv-2211-09490.title: Vesiculation mechanisms mediated by anisotropic proteins
arxiv-2211-09490.creator: Ke Xiao, Chen-Xu Wu, Rui Ma
arxiv-2211-09490.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ke Xiao, Chen-Xu Wu, Rui Ma. Endocytosis is an essential biological process for the trafficking of macromolecules (cargo) and membrane proteins in cells. In yeast cells, this involves the invagination of a tubular structure on the membrane and the formation of endocytic vesicles. Bin/Amphiphysin/Rvs (BAR) proteins holding a crescent-shape are generally assumed to be the active player to squeeze the tubular structure and pinch off the vesicle by forming a scaffold on the side of the tubular membrane.

arxiv-2302-08777.title: Hate Speech and Offensive Language Detection using an Emotion-aware Shared Encoder
arxiv-2302-08777.creator: Khouloud Mnassri, Praboda Rajapaksha, Reza Farahbakhsh, Noel Crespi
arxiv-2302-08777.description: Abstract The rise of emergence of social media platforms has fundamentally altered how people communicate, and among the results of these developments is an increase in online use of abusive content. Therefore, automatically detecting this content is essential for banning inappropriate information, and reducing toxicity and violence on social media platforms.

arxiv-2305-11659.title: Laser harmonic generation with tuneable orbital angular momentum using a structured plasma target
arxiv-2305-11659.creator: R. M. G. M. Trines, H. Schmitz, M. King, P. McKenna, R. Bingham
arxiv-2305-11659.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by R. M. G. M. Trines, H. Schmitz, M. King, P. McKenna, R. Bingham. In previous studies of spin-to-orbital angular momentum (AM) conversion in laser high harmonic generation (HHG) using a plasma target, one unit of spin AM is always converted into precisely one unit of OAM zepf ; li2020 . Here we show, through analytic theory and numerical simulations, that we can exchange one unit of SAM for a tuneable amount of OAM per harmonic step, via the use of a structured plasma target.

arxiv-2308-08689.title: Are we visible to advanced alien civilizations?
arxiv-2308-08689.creator: Z.N. Osmanov
arxiv-2308-08689.description: Abstract We considered the question of how our artificial constructions are visible to advanced extraterrestrial civilizations. Taking the universality of the laws of physics, we found that the maximum distance where the detection is possible is of the order of 3000 3000 ly and under certain conditions Type-II advanced alien societies might be able to resolve this problem.

arxiv-2401-16486.title: Beamfit: Algorithmic Wavefront Reconstruction of Laser Beams Using Multiple Intensity Images and Laguerre- or Hermite-Gaussian Basis. Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2401-16486.creator: Kevin Weber, 1,2,* Jonathan Joseph Carter, 1,2 Sina Maria Koehlenbeck, 1,2 Gudrun Wanner, 1,2 Gerhard Heinzel 1,2
arxiv-2401-16486.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kevin Weber, 1,2,* Jonathan Joseph Carter, 1,2 Sina Maria Koehlenbeck, 1,2 Gudrun Wanner, 1,2 Gerhard Heinzel 1,2. Wavefront errors are a common artifact in laser light generation and imaging. They can be described as an aberration from the spherical wavefront of an ideal Gaussian beam by combinations of higher-order Hermite- or Laguerre-Gaussian terms. Here, we present an algorithm called Beamfit to estimate the mode composition from a series of CCD images taken over the Rayleigh range of a laser beam.

arxiv-2504-06061.title: Non-reciprocal waves in two-dimensional electron systems with temperature gradient
arxiv-2504-06061.creator: Aleksandr S. Petrov
arxiv-2504-06061.description: Abstract We demonstrate that the interaction of dc temperature gradient with ac magnetic field in temperature-biased two-dimensional electron systems leads to formation of a new electromagnetic mode, a two-dimensional thermomagnetic wave (2d TMW). This wave is transverse electric and non-reciprocal, and its damping rate can be lower than that of conventional 2d plasma waves.

arxiv-2506-00270.title: Bayesian Data Sketching for Varying Coefficient Regression Models
arxiv-2506-00270.creator: Rajarshi Guhaniyogi rajguhaniyogi@tamu.edu, Laura Baracaldo lnbaracaldol@ucsb.edu, Sudipto Banerjee sudipto@ucla.edu
arxiv-2506-00270.description: Abstract Varying coefficient models are popular for estimating nonlinear regression functions in functional data models. Their Bayesian variants have received limited attention in large data applications, primarily due to prohibitively slow posterior computations using Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms. We introduce Bayesian data sketching for varying coefficient models to obviate computational challenges presented by large sample sizes.

pmc-10643414.creator: Gabriel Englander, Christopher Costello
pmc-10643414.description: Many countries sell fishing rights to foreign nations and fishers. Although African coastal waters are among the world’s most biologically rich, African countries earn much less than their peers from selling access to foreign fishers. pmc-11353691.description: In recent years, with the rapid development of blockchain technology, the issues of storage load and data security have attracted increasing attention. Due to the immutable nature of data on the blockchain, where data can only be added and not deleted, there is a significant increase in storage pressure on blockchain nodes.

pmc-11414659.title: FDX2, an iron-sulfur cluster assembly factor, is essential to prevent cellular senescence, apoptosis or ferroptosis of ovarian cancer cells
pmc-11414659.creator: Shuko Miyahara, Mai Ohuchi, Miyuki Nomura, Eifumi Hashimoto, Tomoyoshi Soga, Rintaro Saito, Kayoko Hayashi, Taku Sato, Masatoshi Saito, Yoji Yamashita, Muneaki Shimada, Nobuo Yaegashi, Hidekazu Yamada, Nobuhiro Tanuma
pmc-11414659.description: Recent studies reveal that biosynthesis of iron-sulfur clusters (Fe-Ss) is essential for cell proliferation, including that of cancer cells. Nonetheless, it remains unclear how Fe-S biosynthesis functions in cell proliferation/survival. Here, we report that proper Fe-S biosynthesis is essential to prevent cellular senescence, apoptosis, or ferroptosis, depending on cell context.

pmc-11595826.title: Identification and Characterization of Colletotrichum Species Associated with Maize in Sichuan, China
pmc-11595826.creator: Rui Yang, Ying Li, Henan Zhao, Xiaofang Sun, Wen Chen, Pan Li, Xuehu Li, Cuiping Wu, Miaomiao Ma, Guoshu Gong, Nengguo Tao
pmc-11595826.description: Colletotrichum species are the most common cause of maize anthracnose, which often manifests as leaf spots. However, field observations often reveal symptoms similar to those caused by other leaf spot pathogens, such as Curvularia and Bipolaris. In this study, 99 isolates were identified using tissue separation and single-spore isolation techniques.

pmc-12424237.title: Stakeholder readiness in the evolving adult vaccine market
pmc-12424237.creator: Matthew P Jenkins, Anthony Hill, Antonietta F Forte, Verna L Welch, Jane M True, Charles H Jones
pmc-12424237.description: SummaryThe adult vaccine market is undergoing rapid transformation, driven by an aging population and advancements in vaccine technology post-COVID. Research conducted in June 2022 highlights divergent stakeholder perspectives; policy makers and purchasers underestimate emerging challenges, while immunizers and consumers express concern about the increasingly complex vaccine landscape.

pmc-12508566.title: Self-Perceived Psychological, Social, Academic and Personal Impact of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Chiropractic Students in South Africa
pmc-12508566.creator: Danica Strydom, Desiree Varatharajullu, Kirsten Van Heerdan
pmc-12508566.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveThe purpose of this observational study was to determine the social, personal, psychological, and academic self-perceived impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on Chiropractic students in South Africa.MethodsThis study used a quantitative, descriptive, cross-sectional design. A self-reported, Likert-scale survey of 35 online questions, administered through QuestionPro, was sent to Chiropractic students registered at 2 South African institutions from November 2022 until January 2023. The responses were anonymous.
